news.headline: X News: Phantom wallet locks users after scammer dust attacks
news.detail: X News story (updated ~23:37 Berlin) says unsolicited dust payments from malicious addresses can trigger Phantom's compliance filter, disabling sends and swaps in-app while the chain still works; critics say that undercuts self-custody. Story notes dusting has hit millions of Solana wallets; Phantom points to terms of use, and users can export the recovery phrase to another wallet. Relevant for Solana memecoin traders. Unverified beyond the X News summary.
